timing.note: Actual UTC timestamps for evidence capture/replay. Earlier read-only reconnaissance was not separately timed; no image-check time is asserted.

scope.excluded: All scan049 and later data, archive/revisions/initial/before/normalization snapshots, receipts as duplicate observation sources, unimported drafts, and duplicate work copies. Receipts are acceptance evidence only; raw parts corroborate their primary aggregates and are not counted as additional unique observations.

method.serialization: Exactly the existing reconcile.py serialization: four defined fields stringified; primary scan set to committed scan; peer scan stringified. No whitespace, Unicode, wording, place, or semantic normalization.
method.normalization: Imported ErrorAliases from deliverable/scripts/other_error_aliases.py, loaded exact current registry, canonicalized source rows, deduplicated by exact four-field identity only.
method.peer_acceptance: Every ordinary current top-level peer report through048 matched its declared reader, timestamp, type, mark ID/version, reading, confidence, crop (including the importer semicolon serialization for multiple boxes) and observation against actual CHECK_EVENTS. Two further independent versioned events match the current A0001 amendment independent report, which has no other_errors. All through048 independent events are covered.
method.primary_acceptance: Every primary report has its current committed receipt and equal other_errors payload; referenced preserved raw parts examined.

findings.detail: Initial three-alias state had one scan003 registry gap: its two preserved source rows did not exactly map to the historical synthesized table row. Root reviewed both exact rows and applied registry-only OE0002_exact_aliases_003 during this audit, preserving the table and source reports. Current replay under five aliases resolves this gap.

All 15 distinct raw accepted source identities normalize to the 11 current canonical table rows. No accepted source observation is absent and no canonical table row lacks exact or registered provenance. The table is canonical/unique, all five alias source-report hashes match, and all referenced raw-part errors are represented in their primary aggregates.

43 primary reports with committed receipts, 96 referenced preserved raw parts, 66 ordinary imported peer reports (211 events), and one accepted amendment peer report (2 events, no other_errors) examined through scan048. All 213 independent events have preserved report provenance.

row.place: N° 6, cancelled clause between dans les and d’opérateurs
row.what the ink shows: The visible letters form anneaux: a followed by repeated low n/e arches and a final x. The original page is left unchanged outside marks. Independently confirmed; second inspected crop (210,305,1640,485). Both original reports remain in the audit.

row.place: Before f in on a pour \(\forall f\in R_*\), source pixels 1115,1305,1280,1385
row.what the ink shows: The horizontal word before f has a tall initial t-like stroke, a low interior dot/run and a right terminal t. A heavy diagonal crosses the whole group. The scan therefore shows a cancelled word, apparently tout, while the source prints an uncancelled forall symbol.

row.place: After ce qui prouve, the unmarked \deleted{que}; source pixels 675,1690,835,1775
row.what the ink shows: The cancelled group has a looped phi with a long descender, followed by a psi with two raised arms and its own long descender. A horizontal strike passes through both. These are the same mathematical letter shapes used elsewhere on this page, rather than the letters que.

row.place: First marginal integral, above the N_p equality; source bounds [115,1550,315,1750]
row.what the ink shows: The integrand reads s d\nu(s): after the looped d there is a single narrow descending-and-rising nu, then an opening parenthesis and s; no separate lowered f occurs between nu and the parenthesis. Thus the visible correction is \int f\,dm=\int s\,d\nu(s).

row.place: Inserted fidelity sentence, immediately after si and before the deleted A∈𝒜+ (approximately x945–1040, y2155–2198).
row.what the ink shows: There is an additional separately crossed cluster immediately before the marked formula. It begins with a broad curved top and vertical downstroke, continues through an open curved/intersecting group, and ends with an upright stroke. I do not securely identify the letters. All page mark contexts M0300–M0315 were read: none represents this cluster; M0312 represents only the following A-membership-calligraphic-A-plus group. Record the omitted deleted cluster only; do not alter the unmarked source.

row.place: Unmarked words between M0538 and (5), source pixels [1055,1125,1330,1195].
row.what the ink shows: Two distinct d-start words are visible: donc dans (5). The first has a low oval d, a long joined middle, and a detached shallow open c-like terminal; the second has looped d, detached low dot, long baseline and comma-like terminal s, matching the earlier dans at [885,665,1045,735]. This entire additional-word location is outside every listed mark on scan027; M0538 covers the initial d'où and M0539 is on the next line.

row.place: Unmarked $\lambda_n(u)$ immediately before M0790 in the Si la dim paragraph; source pixels approximately [1040,438,1135,483].
row.what the ink shows: The first formula has a small simple vertical subscript 1 under lambda, unlike the broad n-shaped lower index in the second formula at [1250,448,1430,495]. The visible first reading is lambda_1(u); the source formula is outside every page-39 mark and was not changed.

row.place: Immediately after the canceled M0835 expression, before the surviving |Tr p_nu|; source box [612,686,745,739].
row.what the ink shows: The same crossed-out line continues with an additional |\operatorname{Tr}w|: two upright bars enclose a clear T crossbar/stem, low r and rounded w body. This canceled term is omitted from the existing source; it lies outside the marked M0835 span.

row.place: Unmarked vérifie immediately before M0888, around source pixels [900,1305,1125,1370].
row.what the ink shows: The gap after canceled est leads directly into the single word propriété, followed by de v. Its two p descenders and final té leave no separate vérifie token in that position; the unmarked source word appears unsupported by the ink and is not changed here.

row.place: Unmarked $E,F$ immediately before M0920/M0921; source box (310,1355,495,1410).
row.what the ink shows: A third capital G follows the comma after F: its open round body and short inward bar are visible at x430–460, y1370–1398. The sequence is E,F,G; it lies outside every listed mark and is not edited.

row.place: Canceled line after the unstruck qui and immediately before M0954; source insertion boundary outside every listed mark.
row.what the ink shows: A further short canceled word at [305,830,400,895] precedes the tall-f fait of M0954. Its hooked initial, flat low join and final dot resemble the uncanceled qui at [775,1400,855,1450], while an additional qui is visibly present at the previous line end [1545,805,1635,855]. This suggests an omitted repeated canceled qui; independent report work/scan046_peer.json confirms the omission, accepted by the coordinator as a separate unmarked error, and no marked span is altered.
